bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are prohibited, and guests are searched when entering both the fair and amphitheatre. The amphitheatre FAQ does not list a maximum size for other bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Reserved parking is limited and must be bought at least 24 hours before the show; access to that reserved area is through vehicle Gate 4 only. Parking arrangements for concerts outside the annual fair may differ.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The amphitheatre recommends Uber or Lyft for travel to the OC Fair but does not designate a specific pickup curb on its transportation page.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold inside Pacific Amphitheatre and at the OC Fair during fair dates. Outside food and drinks are prohibited in the amphitheatre.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seats can be reserved through the official ticket channel or OC Fair box office. Assisted listening devices are available in the amphitheatre concourse behind the box office; request an interpreter at least 10 business days ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The amphitheatre FAQ says fair guests may return to the fair after a concert, but does not publish a specific policy for re-entering the amphitheatre after leaving it.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: During the OC Fair, Etix will-call tickets are available two hours before the event at the amphitheatre box office or fair concert sales booths; bring the confirmation number and photo ID. Outside fair dates, collect will-call tickets at the amphitheatre box office with ID.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The amphitheatre normally opens 60–90 minutes before the event. During the fair, enter through a fair admission gate and continue to the amphitheatre; outside fair dates, use the main amphitheatre entrance beside its box office.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
